mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of FEDFUNDS level with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 3.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit margins and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 60-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a contraction in the real economy that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during a supply shock regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 during a supply shock regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of PAYEMS with 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, reducing construction sector activity and overall economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak housing starts (HOUST) and high unemployment (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 60-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as higher interest rates reduce the present value of future cash flows, with the effect most pronounced over a 5-day horizon.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 during a monetary tightening cycle.
